contract: ADR 131, NR-04 legacy TUI v3 settings for native explicit execution.

baseline.writer: Actual old TUI theme, locale and local access settings stores, called through their public setters.
baseline.result: The previous packaged Rust binary rejects both public exec and delegated Work with native_capability_inventory_unsupported before model dispatch.

verified.ordinaryAuthority: Explicit ask yielded a real PTY approval, denied by local UI, with no workspace effect.
verified.workAuthority: Canonical workspace policy denied the actual Work call despite the stored full_local preference. The original Tool Result and Evidence recorded the denial with no workspace effect.

limit: Isolated source candidate, controlled local service and synthetic profile. No installed old host, real model, full P4, or release acceptance. The scope covers known theme, Bots default and onboarding flags, language and access preference metadata. Classic and unported settings remain explicitly blocked.
